{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove $ and commas, convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace('[,$]', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Compute conversion rates within each segment
conversion_rates = sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute segment proportions within each channel
segment_proportions = sales.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute weighted average conversion rate per channel
weighted_conversion = pd.Series(index=['email', 'paid_search'], dtype=float)

for channel in ['email', 'paid_search']:
    total = 0
    for segment in ['loyal', 'new', 'returning']:
        rate = conversion_rates[(conversion_rates['channel'] == channel) & (conversion_rates['customer_segment'] == segment)]['converted'].iloc[0]
        prop = segment_proportions.loc[channel, segment]
        total += rate * prop
    weighted_conversion[channel] = total

# Compute difference
difference = weighted_conversion['email'] - weighted_conversion['paid_search']

# Print all required values — this time, only the ones needed in evidence
print(f"weighted_conversion_email = {weighted_conversion['email']}")
print(f"weighted_conversion_paid_search = {weighted_conversion['paid_search']}")
print(f"difference = {difference}")

# Return the values
(weighted_conversion['email'], weighted_conversion['paid_search'], difference)"}
